title: LGR Oddware - MiniDisc Data Storage: Sony MDH-10
summary: An LGR Oddware episode looking at Sony's MDH-10 MD Data drive from 1995, which used MiniDisc for computer storage years before Hi-MD. The host tries out the drive with its original drivers and software.
why: HN cites it as the go-to video on the little-known MD Data format, mostly in MiniDisc and obsolete-media threads.

quote.text: LGR did an Oddware video about it a few years back
